title: Unit 8 Test
subtitle: There is / There are · some / any · prepositions · rooms & furniture · places in town

sections.title: A. Write There’s, There are, There isn’t, or There aren’t.

items.q: ______ a sofa in the living room. (✓)
______ two beds in my bedroom. (✓)
______ a garden. We live in a flat. (✗)
______ any shops in my village. (✗)
______ a lot of books on the shelf. (✓)
______ a microwave in the kitchen. (✗)

sections.title: B. Write questions with Is there or Are there.

items.q: ______ a bank near here?
______ any chairs in the room?
______ a shower in the bathroom?
______ any good restaurants in your town?

sections.title: C. Complete the sentences. Write some or any.

items.q: There are ______ cups on the table.
Are there ______ pictures on the wall?
There aren’t ______ plants in my office.
I have ______ photos of my holiday.
We don’t have ______ eggs.
The cat is ______ the bed. (karavot ostida)
The lamp is ______ the table. (stol ustida)
The bank is ______ to the post office.
My keys are ______ my bag.
The café is ______ the park — just across the road.

sections.title: E. Which room is it? Write the room.

items.q: You cook here. → the ______
You sleep here. → the ______
You have a shower here. → the ______
You watch TV and relax here. → the ______

sections.title: F. Where do you go? Choose the place.

items.q: You want to buy medicine.
You want to see a film.
You want to change money.
You want to send a letter.

sections.title: G. Read the text. Are the sentences true or false?
sections.passage: I live in a small house in Nukus. Downstairs there’s a kitchen and a living room. There isn’t a dining room, so we eat in the kitchen. Upstairs there are two bedrooms and a bathroom. My bedroom is small, but there’s a big window. There aren’t any pictures on the walls, but there are a lot of books. Next to our house there’s a little garden with some apple trees.

items.q: The house is in Nukus.
There’s a dining room downstairs.
There are two bedrooms.
There are a lot of pictures in the bedroom.
There are apple trees in the garden.
